# gsm_project_cluster_allocation_group (Resource)

Manages a cluster allocation group owned by a project. Squadrons in every environment of the project can reference it by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gsm_project_cluster_allocation_group" "default" {
  project_id                    = "<project_id>"
  cluster_allocation_group_name = "kr-default"
  description                   = "Default cluster allocation group for Korea"

  labels = {
    region = "asia"
  }

  targets {
    cluster_name = "<cluster_name>"
    tier         = 1
    weight       = 100
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_allocation_group_name` (String) Name of the cluster allocation group
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the cluster allocation group belongs

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the cluster allocation group
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels used to select this group during allocation
- `profile` (String) Name of a profile block of the provider configuration. Required when the provider configuration has more than one profile block. With one profile block, that profile is used when this is not set
- `targets` (Block List) Clusters that game servers are allocated from (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--targets))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `allocation_destination_name` (String) Name to use in AllocationProfile destinations. It equals cluster_allocation_group_name. Referencing it makes Terraform create the group before the profile, and lets the plan-time preview of the profile accept a group that the same apply creates. It stays unknown until the group is created when the plan cannot read the owner of the group, and a profile that references it then skips the preview
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster name. The cluster must be registered to the project.
- `tier` (Number) Allocation priority tier. Lower tiers are tried first.
- `weight` (Number) Weight for this cluster within the same tier


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)
